_comment: Night generation, 2026-08-18. Mirror unless noted. Reminders ON (generate scaffolded, train unscaffolded). deckType Freeform: Freeform.java validates size only, and these are 2010-2015 tournament lists whose cards ship with XMage so every one is guaranteed implemented. Seat name <=12 chars: server_config.xml maxUserNameLength=14 and the fan-out appends a numeric suffix; longer fails login and burns a 120s bridge timeout per game. NON-MIRROR: pilot plays Boros-Aggro, engine AI plays SelesnyaAggro. A fast deck into a slower one should win more than its own mirror, which serves the requirement that every deck's slice contain wins rather than filtering for them after.
